messages.text:
Which app do you mean? If it's the Harlo OS dashboard on our miners, that's the built-in interface you reach over your network, and it works. If you mean the Helium Mobile or Helium hotspot app, that's Helium's own app, not ours.

Tell me which one and what you're trying to do, and I'll give you a straight answer.
there  a app called heliumdeploy app

I'm not able to confirm one from here, so I won't guess. What would you want it to do, monitor a miner or manage a hotspot? If it's miner monitoring, that runs through Harlo OS on the unit itself at harlolabs.com.

I've passed the app question to Georges. The team is offline now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

You're right, it exists, my mistake. app.heliumdeploy.com is our app for monitoring and managing your ASIC miners from anywhere, so you can see your units remotely rather than only on the local network.

I can't test what's live on it from here. What were you hoping to do with it, check a miner you already have, or see how it works before you buy?
i not able to download it at the moment

It runs in your browser, there's nothing to download. Just open app.heliumdeploy.com and sign in. On a phone you can add it to your home screen from the browser menu, which makes it look like an app.

If you're hitting an error or a blank page, tell me what you see and on which browser, and I'll pass the exact detail on.
*(handing this to our technical specialist, who'll answer here.)*
